body:
At around 11am, I took half a tab of what was supposedly 240ug of LSD Beatles blotter. At around the 30 minute mark, the room started breathing. Patterns started to form, light trails started to appear.
An hour in, I was sucked out of this world. I've entered another world. As I walked in, two entities were beside me, judging whether my reality is sufficiently explored to allow me in. When they gave the green light, I walked in and the council of nine was there to greet me. Entities, who look just like us, except, they weren't fighting and they had looks on their faces, like they have the answers to all the questions. They smiled and then they started debating on whether I should be let in on all this. Suddenly I'm thrown back into my room.
2 hours in, I was back in my room and the visuals by this time were in full swing, colours were warping back and forth, patterns seem to combine and recombine infinitely, but strangely, everything was working together and one. Even the world outside was warping right before my eyes. I put on some Sigur Ros and enjoyed the rest of the trip.
